children: You don’t have to carry it alone
Warm, down-to-earth counseling for individuals, couples and teens — in a real room or over secure video. Start with a free consultation, no pressure to continue.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every one of our clinicians is fully licensed and experienced — and, just as importantly, warm, patient and easy to talk to.
Come sit in one of our quiet offices, or meet from home over secure telehealth. Same care either way — you choose what feels right.
We accept most major insurance plans and keep a limited number of reduced-fee spots, so cost is one less thing to worry about.
Whatever brought you here, you’ll be met with respect and zero judgment. This is your hour — you set the pace.

children: Therapy that meets you where you are

Anchor Counseling started with a simple belief: asking for help should feel human, not clinical. So we built a practice around long conversations, real relationships and the same familiar therapist each time.
You won’t be handed a worksheet and rushed out. We take the time to understand your story, and we work at a pace that feels safe — because that’s where change actually happens.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Anchor Counseling is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, sunlit therapy room with a soft couch and warm wood

children: We’re a small, established counseling practice — the kind of place where the therapist remembers your name and your story, and where the waiting room feels more like a living room than a clinic.
Our name is the whole idea. An anchor doesn’t stop the storm; it keeps you steady through it. That’s what good therapy does, and it’s what we set out to offer: a steady, human place to do the work.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: What working with us is like
Your first session is about your story — what brought you in, what you’re hoping for, and how you like to work. No script, no rush.
You’re never bounced between clinicians. You build a real relationship with one person who knows your history and your goals.
What you share stays between you and your therapist. This is a private, protected space — that’s the foundation everything else stands on.
